The '''Xoxin plains''' were a plain of [[Xoxin plains|xoxin]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eres III]]. In [[3962 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] set fire to the highly-flammable fields during the [[Battle of Eres III]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The plains continued to burn until at least [[3951 BBY]].
